title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Launch Edition (PS5)

comparisons.notes: Same item (same model and variant) listed new and in stock at Best Buy, checked 2026-10-30T23:03:00-04:00.

writeup: Metaphor: ReFantazio, the 2024 fantasy RPG from Atlus (the studio behind Persona), is back on Woot in its physical PS5 Launch Edition for $19.99. Best Buy currently lists the same Launch Edition at $39.99, so this restock comes in at about half that price. Woot shows only one unit left with a limit of one per customer, so it likely will not last long.
